LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her hip.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. AVOID: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
